value.rationale: The natural exactly-one-particle site observable is not monotone in occupation, so conventional canonical anticorrelation intuition does not apply. The theorem explains a uniform positive-association mechanism at half filling even as ordinary occupation numbers remain strictly anticorrelated, and identifies a sharp square-root load threshold where the mesoscopic sign changes for all fixed deformations. The quantified quadratic versus linear inverse-size scale contrast and complete finite t=1 sign boundary are structural, physically interpretable finite-size transport diagnostics. No unsupported broader-transport or experimental claim is made.
